items.title: `std::ui`: no pointer capture, so a drag that leaves its element stops (a text selection stops extending outside the field)
items.discussion: found by lane kit-a (Order 58, 2026-11-12) building `kit::text_input`; pointer moves go only to the element under the pointer; `tests/ui/todo-check.txt` records today's behaviour
items.body: While a button is held, pointer moves and the release should go to the element that took the press (implicit capture, as the web and GPUI do), with the option to release it. Needed by drag selection, sliders, scrollbar thumbs, drag and drop. Decide: implicit capture on press for every element that listens, or an explicit `capture_pointer()`. Also from the same lane, same area, smaller: double-click selects a word; a blinking caret (steady today so an idle window draws nothing; a blink needs a timer that stops when the window loses focus).

items.title: `std::ui::kit::text_input` has no clipboard: winit 0.30 has no clipboard API and the gfx crate has no clipboard dependency
items.kind: feature gap (native UI; dependency question) — OWNER RULING on the dependency
items.discussion: lane kit-a (Order 58, 2026-11-12); `x11rb` is only a dev-dependency of the gfx crate
items.body: Cut, copy and paste need a clipboard on X11, Wayland, Windows and macOS. Options: `arboard` (the common crate; pulls platform clipboard crates), or our own per platform. QUESTION for the owner: accept `arboard` (pinned, in the gfx crate's notices) or write it. Integrator's recommendation: `arboard`, pinned, behind a `std::gfx` clipboard surface of two functions, so the dependency is replaceable. IME composition (P5) is separate; the edit state leaves room for a preedit run at the caret.
